lines.trans: You are too polite—think nothing of it.
I think I know what is on your mind.
So you already found out why I left university back then?
Of course—you should pursue your studies wherever you wish.
I wonder what score I earned in your background check?
As long as you feel reassured about Bu Xiaogu working on my team, that is good.
As for your advice to stay patient, I will gladly take it.
Rest assured with Huimei in my care.
And as for mentoring Xiaogu at Xingtian, leave her to me.
Both of us will look after them well.
